author: TeIq
content:
## Source
.design/m5/43-federation.md — REQ-2, REQ-3, AC-3, AC-6 + decomposition PR 1.

## Surface
- New module: `polaris-backend/src/federation/mod.rs`
- New file: `polaris-backend/src/federation/peer_subscribe.rs` — one `proto_blue::repo::Firehose` per configured peer DID, filtered to Polaris NSIDs.
- New file: `polaris-backend/src/federation/verify.rs` — K-256 signature verification using `proto-blue-crypto`. Resolves peer's public key by fetching the peer's `app.bsky.labeler.service` record on first contact; caches with a TTL.
- New migration: `migrations/NNN_federation_quarantine.sql` — `federation_quarantine` table (cid TEXT PRIMARY KEY, source_did TEXT, nsid TEXT, raw_cbor BYTEA, received_at TIMESTAMPTZ, signature_status TEXT).
- Config: extend `[federation]` section in `polaris.toml` with `[[federation_peers]] did = ... direction = ...` blocks.

## Scope
- **Read-only** — incoming records land in `federation_quarantine`, NOT the active case stream. The materialization path (quarantine → case store) is PR 2.
- Signature verification at the boundary: failures land in quarantine with `signature_status = 'verify_failed'` + a WARN log (REQ-6 / AC-6).

## Rust-quality notes
- **One JoinSet per peer.** Per rust-quality §10: `JoinSet<Result<(), FederationError>>` so a single peer's task failure cannot bring down the federation worker. Use `tokio_util::sync::CancellationToken` for graceful shutdown.
- **`tokio::select!` cancel-safety** on the per-peer reconnect loop. Pin the Firehose future via `tokio::pin!` outside the loop; pass `&mut fut` into `select!`.
- **`FederationError` is a `thiserror` enum.** Variants: `PeerNotConfigured(Did)`, `SignatureVerifyFailed { cid: Cid, did: Did }`, `RepoFetchFailed { did: Did, source: proto_blue::Error }`, `QuarantineWriteFailed(#[from] sqlx::Error)`.
- **Idempotent insert.** `INSERT INTO federation_quarantine (cid, …) ON CONFLICT (cid) DO NOTHING` — replay-on-reconnect must not double-write.
- Public-key resolver: cache for 6h (matches Bluesky's stated PLC TTL conventions); refresh on signature_verify_failed since the peer may have rotated. Use `moka` (already in workspace deps via tower-http if present, else add at workspace level).
- The DPoP / OAuth / cookie path is NOT involved here — federation is server-to-server reading public PDS data. No moderator session.

## External references
- proto-blue Firehose: `/home/doll/proto-blue/proto-blue/proto-blue/src/repo.rs`
- v1 firehose reference impl in-repo: `polaris-backend/src/ingest/firehose.rs`
- proto-blue-crypto verify_signature: `/home/doll/proto-blue/proto-blue/proto-blue-crypto/src/lib.rs`
- ATProto labeler.service record (peer pubkey source): https://atproto.com/specs/lexicon

## Acceptance (AC-3, AC-6 partial)
- [ ] Two-instance fixture: peer A publishes a `polaris.escalation`; peer B's federation worker materializes it into `federation_quarantine` within 10s.
- [ ] Forged signature on a federation record → quarantined with WARN log, NOT inserted into any other table.
- [ ] Unit test on the cancel-safe select loop: drop the runtime mid-poll, confirm no progress is lost.
